status: THE RELIC ABUNDANCE IS COMPUTED (O7). The freeze-out integral reproduces the WIMP miracle (Omega h^2 = 0.080 at 100 GeV with sigma v = 3e-26 cm^3/s). At the ladder mass m = 118.6 GeV the measured Omega h^2 = 0.120 requires sigma v = 1.98e-26 cm^3/s, i.e. alpha_eff = 0.0086 in sigma v = alpha^2/(pi m^2) - while the theory supplies only the loop factor 1/16pi = 0.0199 (Omega h^2 = 0.0246) or the root g10^2/4pi = 0.0032 (Omega h^2 = 0.798). The automaton's own light spectrum matters: 12 M nodes, each a one-dimensional node subspace at |omega| = 2.0e-04 with a rank-1 velocity metric and commuting tangent velocities (max 0.0e+00) - nodal planes, not cones - so the final-state density is enhanced by D = sum 1/|v|^3 = 1485.3 (mean |v| = 0.201), which the dm_wimp (100/m)^3 ansatz never sees; with it the supplied couplings give Omega h^2 = 2.25e-05 and 0.00076. The named portals reproduce 0.120 only because their lambda was inverted from the fiducial 3e-26 cm^3/s (computed: 0.081 and 0.156; with doublers 0.000 and 0.000). VERDICT: the abundance is a computed number, and it is NOT 0.120 for any coupling the root supplies - the WIMP miracle of Fig. 2 is a mass-scaling ansatz, and the doubler spectrum changes the annihilation rate by the factor D.
